en: A black-and-white vintage postcard depicting a street scene in front of a two-story building, characteristic of Central European urban architecture from the late 19th or early 20th century. The building houses several shops, with visible signage above the windows and on the corner. A few people, including children, are seen walking or standing on the cobblestone street. The upper left corner includes printed text identifying 'Josefov. Josefstäd.'
